image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on a cluster of small pink flowers. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is characterized by a uniform brown color and distinct rows of eyespots (ocelli) with white centers and black rings. The background consists of soft-focus green foliage and more pink flowers.
